theme.description: Cozy, hand-drawn/cartoon aesthetic with warm tones. The UI represents a 'cozy digital lounge' blending 2D canvas illustrations with tactile, rounded HTML overlays.

headings.usage: Use for all modal titles, character names, and floating labels.

body.usage: Use for chat bubbles, control buttons, and subtext.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Pastel & Soft
rules: Avoid pure black (#000000). Use 'espresso' (#3E2723) for dark text.
Avoid pure white backgrounds for main areas. Use 'cream' (#FDFBF7).
Use 'chai_orange' for primary actions and active states.
Never use full-screen gradients. Keep the background feeling like a painted or solid wood surface.

surface_styles.control_bar: bg-[#FDFBF7] border-4 border-[#3E2723] rounded-full shadow-[0_8px_0px_#3E2723] mb-8
surface_styles.chat_bubble: bg-white border-2 border-[#3E2723] rounded-2xl rounded-bl-none shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#3E2723]

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlays over the canvas to give it a 'paper' or 'lo-fi' feel.

elements.name: Canvas layer
elements.classes: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full z-0 bg-[#D7B586]

elements.name: Live Chat Overlay
elements.classes: absolute top-0 right-0 h-full w-80 z-10 flex flex-col p-4

elements.name: Bottom Control Bar
elements.classes: absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 flex gap-4 px-8 py-4

startup_modal.classes: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#3E2723]/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-4

components.name: AvatarSetupModal
components.description: Form for user to enter name, select beverage, and customize avatar head.
components.ui_instructions: Use chunky buttons for selection. Highlight selected items with a solid Chai Orange background and Espresso border.

components.name: LoungeCanvas
components.ui_instructions: Draw the central wooden table. Render avatars radially around the table center. Animate steam and floating emojis upwards from the avatars.

components.name: ChatPanel
components.ui_instructions: Render messages inside 'chat_bubble' style. Use 'flex-col-reverse' or auto-scroll to bottom.

components.name: ControlBar
components.description: Island at the bottom of the screen with action buttons.
components.ui_instructions: Buttons should have a 3D press effect: translate-y-1 and shadow reduction on active/click.

rules: Modals: Framer motion pop-in (scale 0.9 to 1, opacity 0 to 1, spring stiffness 300)
Avatars (Canvas): Gentle floating animation (sine wave on Y axis).
Speech Bubbles/Emojis: Float up and fade out (y: -20, opacity: 0 over 2 seconds)

canvas_libraries: Use raw HTML5 Canvas API for rendering the 2D lounge, table, and avatars.
Alternatively, use a lightweight wrapper if preferred, but raw 2D context is sufficient for basic shapes and images.

startup_background.description: Isometric cozy cafe background for the setup screen

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #3E2723 text passes WCAG AA against #FDFBF7 background.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, inputs, and canvas wrappers MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='drink-button', data-testid='avatar-setup-form').
accessibility.focus: Add focus:ring-4 focus:ring-chai_orange to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use HTML5 Canvas for the Lounge. The table and avatars should be drawn on the canvas context.
The UI (Chat, Controls, Setup Modal) should be built with React, HTML, and Tailwind overlaying the Canvas (using z-index).
Avatars can be simple 2D shapes (circles for heads, simple ears for animals) drawn directly via Canvas ctx.arc/ctx.bezierCurveTo to keep it lightweight.
Use WebSockets (e.g., standard WebSocket or Socket.io) for real-time state sync (positions, actions, chat). State should be kept in memory.
Simulate NPCs by running a setInterval that randomly triggers chat messages and 'drink' animations for 3 hardcoded bot users.
Include simple Web Audio API or HTML Audio for the 'slurp' sound effect when the drink action is triggered.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. Text alignment should flow naturally.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for all modal contents.
Avoid generic SaaS gradients. Stick to the flat, solid, 'neobrutalist/clay' aesthetic defined in the surface styles.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties (e.g., `transition: transform 0.2s, background-color 0.2s`).
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Ensure the canvas is responsive. Handle window resize events to redraw the canvas content correctly.
